comment: Rider sprite descriptor (docs/RideWorld.md#rider-sprite). Layered: each layer is a manifest role, drawn in this order. Frames are frameSize; anchor = the pixel on the road between the wheels. The Explorer's run cycle is drawn over the bike (its 46x44 cells scaled ~2.1x so the hips sit on the saddle and the feet on the pedals); to go back to the drawn legs + torso, use the rider_legs and rider_torso layers (see DefaultSpriteDescriptor).
